name: chronicle
description: Timestamps on every message, dates where the day changes, a usage line on each reply, live status line, limit alerts and a usage dashboard (/chronicle).

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: auto (this machine's zone), an IANA name like Europe/Berlin, or an offset like +02:00. Cloud sessions run on UTC, so set it there.

dateFormat.title: Date format
dateFormat.description: weekday: Mon 12 Oct 2026 · iso: 2026-10-12 · us: Mon, Oct 12, 2026 · eu: Mon 12.10.2026

showElapsed.title: Show elapsed time
showElapsed.description: Add +12s to replies (time since your prompt) and 2h later to prompts after a break.

turnFooter.title: Usage line on replies
turnFooter.description: End each turn's last reply with its time, duration, cost, tokens and context.

footerStyle.title: Usage line detail
footerStyle.description: full: time, duration, cost, tokens, cache, context, tools · compact: time, duration, cost, context.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Pin a live clock, cost, context and rate-limit line under the prompt.

statusStyle.title: Status line detail
statusStyle.description: full: with burn rate and reset times · compact: the numbers only.

alerts.title: Limit alerts
alerts.description: Notify at 50/80/95% of a rate limit, when you're on pace to run out before the reset, and at 75/90% context.
